parameters.name: BindPortList
parameters.description: The ports that are bound to the probe.

sub_parameters.name: BindPort
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to bind the port. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

sub_parameters.name: EndPort
sub_parameters.description: The end port on which the probe monitors.

sub_parameters.name: Fixed
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the port is a fixed port. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

sub_parameters.name: Proto
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the protocol. Valid values:

*   **tcp**
*   **udp**

sub_parameters.name: StartPort
sub_parameters.description: The start port on which the probe monitors.

parameters.name: HoneypotId
parameters.description:
The honeypot ID.

>  You can call the [ListHoneypot](~~ListHoneypot~~) operation to query the IDs of honeypots.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ProbeId
parameters.description:
The probe ID.

>  You can call the [ListHoneypotProbe](~~ListHoneypotProbe~~) operation to query the IDs of probes.

parameters.name: ServiceIpList
parameters.description: The IP addresses that are monitored.
